summary: HDFC Bank filed a Form 6-K disclosing routine equity compensation grants approved by its Governance, Nomination, and Remuneration Committee on September 6, 2026. The grants included 5,86,95,020 stock options at Rs. 712.10 per share and 2,90,430 options at the same price under ESOS 063 and ESOS 064, plus restricted stock units under RSU 018 and RSU 019, all with four-stage vesting over up to four years. These are standard employee incentive awards under SEBI regulations, not a special situation. No deal terms apply. This filing is routine compensation disclosure, not a corporate event.
